summary_en: This phase 1 trial tests the safety, side effects, and best dose of MUC1-activated T cells, made from the patient's own blood, in people with relapsed or resistant ovarian cancer. The T cells are given by IV on day 0, or on days 0 and 21, after leukapheresis and IV cyclophosphamide or bendamustine given before the T cells. The study measures safety, side effects, and the best dose.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 1 evalúa la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y la mejor dosis de células T activadas con MUC1, elaboradas a partir de la sangre de la propia paciente, en personas con cáncer de ovario recidivante o resistente. Las células T se administran por vía intravenosa el día 0, o los días 0 y 21, después de una leucaféresis y de cyclophosphamide o bendamustina por vía intravenosa administradas antes de las células T. El estudio mide la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y la mejor dosis.
who_for: Age 18 or older with epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, carcinosarcoma, or primary peritoneal cancer.
Relapsed or refractory disease after at least one prior line of platinum chemotherapy.
Measurable disease, with at least one lesion of 1 cm or more on imaging.
MUC1 expression on tumor cells by immunohistochemistry, with a staining score above 0.
not_for: Pregnant or nursing persons, or those of childbearing potential not using birth control.
Myocardial infarction within 6 months, or heart failure needing ongoing treatment.
Active autoimmune disease needing systemic treatment within 30 days.
